title: instructional-cadence
description: Course pacing as music: one measure per lesson, one beat per page, scored on a five-part lesson shape. For the HAXcms Site Insights dashboard.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: JSON Outline Schema items ({id, parent, title, slug, order})

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: one row per page: {id, words, images, videos, embeds}

attributes.name: course-title
attributes.description: Title used on the engraved score

attributes.name: base-path
attributes.description: Prefix for page links, e.g. the site's base path

attributes.name: lesson-depth
attributes.description: Outline level that holds the lessons; -1 finds it from the outline

attributes.name: hide-stats
attributes.description: Skip the summary numbers (when the host shows its own)
